title: USCIS offices
intro: Office-level data to compare paces. They are approximate: USCIS does not publish a Cuban Adjustment category by office.
list.focus: Offices with the most Cuban cases
list.showFocus: See only the offices with the most Cuban cases
row.title: {name} ({code}) · {state}
empty: There are no offices with data for this filter.
pt.title: USCIS times: family-based I-485 (131A-FAM)
pt.proxy: Family-based: the closest reference; there is no Cuban Adjustment category.
pt.missing: Time within which {p} of cases were completed: not available ({source}, {date}).
hum.none: There is no quarterly data for this office.
hum.note: Humanitarian cases: includes refugees and asylees, not only Cubans.
mult.line: Relative pace of the office: {m} ({n} approvals in {q} quarters)
mult.none: Not enough data to compare this office's pace.
detail.title: {name} ({code})
detail.notFound: We could not find the office "{code}" in the data.
detail.sources: Sources: USCIS I-485 by office (quarterly report) and the USCIS processing times tool (via a community copy). The relative pace is an index with little data, pulled toward the average.
trend.title: Quarterly trend
trend.caption: Humanitarian cases by quarter at {name}. Source: USCIS, I-485 by office.
history.title: How the case-inquiry date has moved
history.caption: Family-based I-485 case-inquiry dates published for {name}.
history.none: There are no earlier publications of the case-inquiry date for this office.
eta.title: When would the case-inquiry date reach your receipt date?
eta.fromCase: We use the receipt date of your saved case. You can change it here without changing your case.
eta.pick: Choose a date to run the calculation.
eta.result: If you filed on {date}, the case-inquiry date would have to reach it: ≈ {month} (rough calculation).
eta.passed: Your receipt date ({date}) is earlier than the published case-inquiry date ({inquiry}): according to USCIS, the case would be outside normal processing time.
eta.depends: There are not enough publications of the case-inquiry date to calculate it ({n}); we cannot say whether it has been reached.
eta.method: Calculation: the pace at which the case-inquiry date moved between {from} and {to}, extended forward. It is not a promise: the date can stall or move back.
eta.privacy: The date is used on this screen only and is not saved.
